Chuck Norris Dies at 86: Faith, Film, and Legacy

Born March 10, 1940, Chuck Norris passed away March 19, 2026. Known for martial arts and film, he was also outspoken about his faith in Jesus Christ. Norris often credited God for his success and used his platform to promote Christian values, leaving behind a legacy that extended far beyond Hollywood.
